authority.why_this_source: The board's own published mark scheme, and the most recent Paper 2 sitting on disk. Preferred over the older 1EN0_02_rms_20180111.pdf in the courses tree, and over the .md transcriptions beside it — the gate re-opens PDFs, so a markdown transcription can never be the authority.
authority.folder_note: The folder name 'Makr Schemes' is misspelt on the drive. Kept verbatim — the path must resolve.
authority.numbering_note: ⚠️ The board numbers the both-texts questions 7(a) and 7(b), and offers Section B as 'Question 8 or 9'. An earlier cut of this file invented Q7/Q8/Q9 as three separate questions; our spec's Q7a/Q7b/Q8 was right and the invention was wrong. Corrected against the board's own summary grid.

total.why: The mark scheme states each tariff in a per-question summary grid. 2+2+15+1+1+15+6+14 = 56 (Section A) + 40 (Section B) = 96, matching language-paper-specs.json.
